messages:
jess: Anyone free to sanity-check a console feature idea? A per-route protocol toggle (rest | grpc | dualstack) + a canary slider. Need to show telemetry/quota impact in the UI.

omar: Per-route gives teams granularity but explodes surface area. Suggest tenant-default + per-route opt-in. Easier to audit.

liam: Runtime-wise router can honor per-route flags. Main risks: transcoding CPU overhead and KV cache churn when we alter path->method mapping. Need to simulate cache invalidation for rollout.

sasha: Also tracing — gateway transcode creates two logical spans for one request unless we attach a delegation id. Sampling will bias metrics if transcode is rare.

kate: For the console we should show: pct grpc vs rest, avg latency delta, and a trace annotation indicating "transcoded" with a link to the two stitched spans. Ops will want that for postmortems.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: protocol-toggle canary for service `generator-service` -> 10% grpc rollout at 2026-03-05T10:00Z. Logs in #eng-platform-canaries.

omar: We need strict rules for what we allow to transcode: no bidi streams, disallow Any/polymorphic fields, and require 1:1 method mapping. Otherwise semantics diverge.

jess: Agreement proposal: proto is source-of-truth for contract. Mark routes `transcode_allowed` explicitly. Browser-origin routes default to rest unless teams opt in. Add header `x-redwood-proto: v1` for explicit proto clients.

liam: Implementation knobs: per-route config keys `protocol_mode: rest|grpc|dualstack`, `canary_percent`, and `transcode_allowed: true|false`. Router adds tag `protocol.choice` to spans. Batching behavior differs for dualstack.

sasha: Telemetry schema: add `protocol.choice` and `transcode=true|false`. Record ingress/egress bytes; for traces, keep higher sampling for transcode traces during first 14 days of any rollout.

kate: Quotas: charge the backend method post-transcode but map that charge back to the consumer route for visibility. Console should show both the charged method and the originating route.

omar: Edge case: grpc-web in browsers is flaky. If route is browser-facing, the console should warn and recommend our polyfill or fallback to rest.

jess: UX mock: toggle + canary slider (0-100) + preflight check button that runs a compatibility test against a sample payloads set and lists field remaps/losses. Yellow warning if any field would be dropped.

liam: Caveat: the preflight needs to run against the active model of the backend (pin to version) because differing proto versions can change mapping. Also add automated smoke tests in the canary flow.

sasha: Action items: (1) header conventions: `x-redwood-proto` + `x-redwood-transcode`, (2) telemetry columns and dashboard mockups, (3) quota mapping doc and sample queries.

jess: I'll draft an RFC tonight with console mockups and examples. Can we prototype this sprint? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

kate: +1 :thumbsup:

omar: +1 :thumbsup:

liam: +1 :thumbsup: schedule a 20m demo with infra for next week so we can validate runtime knobs.

sasha: +1, and let's capture a runbook for rollback if transcode causes data loss.

deploy-bot: Canary created at 2026-03-05T09:55Z for `generator-service` route (10% -> grpc). Monitor: latency, error-rate, and trace-diff ratio.
